verdict.rationale: Vanta's own product pages give HIPAA, GDPR and PCI their own dedicated pages, each with automated evidence and continuous monitoring. The homepage claims 35+ frameworks, and the GRC page says controls can be cross-mapped across pre-built frameworks and automated across multiple frameworks in one platform. So a new framework requirement is handled within the same tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of HIPAA/GDPR/PCI DSS depth, and explicit naming of PCI DSS (the PCI page quote refers only to 'new frameworks').

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and 35+ frameworks—automated and continuously monitored.
